invented.quote: What sets him apart is that he has gone beyond the work he was hired to do.
invented.why: The brief does not mention what duties Tomás was originally hired to perform.

invented.quote: He learned our herd management software on his own initiative
invented.why: The brief states that he learned the software, but does not say he did so on his own initiative rather than being asked or trained as part of his job.

invented.quote: he found those cases by paying attention to the data and to the animals.
invented.why: The brief says he caught the cases and that he uses software to flag sick cows, but does not state how he detected those specific cases.

invented.quote: when he went home to Mexico
